messages:
support-bot: New P1 from Support — customer acme-inc seeing 500s hitting /v1/generate. Rate limiter returning 500 instead of a 429 when quota service times out. request_id=req_0ab12cd3, sample attached.

maria: customer report: started ~2026-02-19T14:22:00Z. High error rate, some requests succeed but many get 500. They expect 429 when rate limited. CSM is on the line.

kevin: looking. Can you paste the last 10s of proxy logs and the gateway -> quota-service spans? Also which region and model?

maria: region=us-west-2, model=gpt-medium, customer route=acct/acme-inc. repro curl below.

maria: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'x-request-id: req_0ab12cd3'```

maria: proxy excerpt (sanitized):
```
[14:22:03] proxy: req=req_0ab12cd3 -> ratecheck.call
[14:22:03] ratecheck: calling quota-orch us-west-2://quota-orch-12
[14:22:04] quota-orch-12: upstream_timeout after 1500ms
[14:22:04] ratecheck: upstream error -> classify(500)
[14:22:04] proxy: returning 500 to client req=req_0ab12cd3
```

kevin: aha. quota-orch returned timeout, service code path classified that as 500. We should have a classifier that maps quota timeouts to 429 or a temporary 503 with retry/backoff.

ashley: quick mitigation options: 1) flip quota classifier to treat dependency timeouts as 429 for user-visible behaviour, 2) enable ratecheck fallback to local token bucket for known enterprise accounts, 3) scale quota-orch pool. Option 1 is safest for customer-facing consistency.

samir: I can push a config change to the routing/classifier feature flag. Admin API: `POST /admin/rlimit/config` body `{ "timeout_behavior": "map_dep_timeout_to_429" }`

julia: I'll take the rollout. Doing canary to 10% on us-west-2.

julia: @deploy-bot starting rollout canary -> feature=rlimit-timeout-mapping scope=us-west-2 pct=10 :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy started by julia for feature rlimit-timeout-mapping (canary 10%)

kevin: while that's rolling, also please capture spans for the quota-orch instances (conn reuses, CPU) — sounds like transient upstream hangs.

maria: CSM asked for ETA to restore expected 429 semantics. Julia, can you confirm?

julia: canary applied to 10% in us-west-2. Observing traffic now. If error rate improves and customer sees 429, we'll ramp to 100% in 5m.

support-bot: monitoring alert fired: error_rate(/v1/generate, acct=acme-inc) > 10% (14:23:10 -> 14:24:00)

julia: 14:24:30 canary looks good. acme-inc requests now return 429s for quota timeouts. Ramping to 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: feature rlimit-timeout-mapping rolled to 100% in us-west-2 by julia

ashley: follow-up: we should still investigate why quota-orch had upstream_timeout (1500ms). Maybe connection pool exhaustion or a GC hiccup on that pod group. kevin, can you schedule a deeper postmortem?

kevin: will take. Captured metrics: quota-orch p95 latency spike at 14:21:58, connection errors increased. I'll grab heap/cpu profiles and check host-level IO. Creating incident board.

maria: customer notified that we've mitigated and restored 429 behavior; CSM escalations updated. They want RCA once available.

samir: note for postmortem: add regression test to ensure classifier maps dependency timeouts to 429 for rate-limit path.

kevin: assigning follow-up actions:
- KEVIN: collect quota-orch instance traces + logs (started)
- ASHLEY: review classifier mapping unit tests + PR (#12345)
- SAMIR: add canary playbook entry for this feature
- MARIA: keep CSM updated and collect customer repro logs

maria: thanks all. leaving thread for now. :thumbsup:

kevin: quick paste of relevant log lines for PM:
```
E [quota-orch] 14:21:58 conn_pool.exhausted -> waiting_for_conn
W [quota-orch] 14:22:00 request handler hit deadline -> upstream_timeout
I [ratecheck] 14:22:00 classify_timeout -> currently mapped to 500
```

ashley: opened PR to change mapping + add test: https://git.redwood.ai/eng/rlimit/+/PR-12345 :shipit:

kevin: leaving notes for PM: check autoscaling config for quota-orch (min 3 -> consider 5), look at retry budgets.

maria: CSM confirms customer saw reduced impact by 14:25 UTC. Closing P1 after RCA posted.

support-bot: incident resolved: mitigation applied, full rollout complete, follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
